mapper.select: SELECT id,profile_json,enabled,created_at FROM bike_pi_fulfillment_profile ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id,profile_json,enabled,created_at FROM bike_pi_fulfillment_profile WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,profile_json,enabled,created_at FROM bike_pi_fulfillment_profile WHERE profile_code=#{code} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi_fulfillment_profile SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_pi_confirmation_attachment WHERE pi_id=#{piId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_order_reservation(order_id,source_lock_id,request_id,model_id,reserved_qty,expires_at,scope_type,hold_mode,payment_hold_pi_id,payment_held_at,payment_held_by,payment_held_amount) SELECT #{orderId},id,CONCAT('PI_CREDIT_',#{piId},'_',#{orderId}),product_model_id,lock_qty,NOW(3),'SKU','CREDIT',#{piId},NOW(3),#{operatorId},0 FROM bike_inventory_lock WHERE id=#{lockId}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_order_reservation SET hold_mode='CREDIT',payment_hold_pi_id=#{piId},payment_held_at=NOW(3),payment_held_by=#{operatorId},released_at=NULL WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND hold_mode IN ('TIMED','CREDIT')
